news.title: Exploring the world's languages with Language Explorer
ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
news.body: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

news.title: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan: A Synthetic Dataset Capturing Japan's Demographics and Financial Context
Introducing Control Room: Human control over AI workloads
news.body: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

news.title: HOPE 在专家剪枝中考虑协作关系
news.body: 文章讨论混合专家模型推理时的显存占用，并提出在剪枝时考虑专家之间的联合贡献。效果依赖校准数据和模型结构，压缩后的任务表现需单独评估。
news.title_original: Your Experts Have Partners. There's HOPE for Keeping Them Together

news.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
news.body: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

news.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
news.body: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

news.title: WorldParticle 用统一架构模拟多类物理过程
news.body: MIT、UBC 等团队介绍将不同物理现象纳入单一深度学习系统的方法，涵盖颗粒、流体及分子等场景。跨现象建模能力仍需按具体体系与耦合条件验证。
news.title_original: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins
news.body_original: By learning how matter moves, the WorldParticle system could assist with developing soft robots, medicines, and more.

news.title: FLEX 帮助机器人从自然语言反馈中调整运动规划
news.body: 研究以特征编辑流程将对话指令转化为更一般的规划偏好，并在多个仿真场景演示。实际机器人部署与复杂环境泛化仍需进一步评估。
news.title_original: AI-assisted learning platform helps robots reason beyond literal commands
news.body_original: The new approach, known as FLEX, could lead to more intuitive, interactive household and assistive robots.

news.title: ToyBlocks 提供可控的机器人学习与评估环境
news.body: Allen AI 介绍 FoundationWorlds 框架，将模拟世界、自动任务与示范生成和行为指标结合。ToyBlocks 用于研究数据与模型设计如何影响学习，结果取决于受控仿真条件。
news.title_original: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation

news.title: MIT 探索少样本条件下的分子性质预测
news.body: 报道介绍在目标性质数据较少时辅助筛选候选分子的方法，涉及潜在药物靶点的配体亲和力等任务。结果依赖所测数据与性质，候选仍需计算和实验检验。
news.title_original: How to predict the behavior of molecules from scant data
news.body_original: A machine-learning approach called CheMeleon provides a practical way to develop new drugs or other molecules with much less detailed, expensive experimentation.

news.title: OpenAI 与 Hacktron 合作寻找系统漏洞
news.body: 公告介绍与独立安全研究团队合作发现和报告弱点，并指向漏洞赏金计划的授权范围。合作成果与修复状态需按具体发现分别核验。
news.title_original: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
news.body_original: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

news.title: BioBasicsBench 评估日常湿实验数据分析能力
news.body: 基准包含 100 项任务，考察智能体解释原始实验数据、识别错误和判断证据是否充分的能力。结果显示图像解读、对照检查及实验情境应用仍有改进空间。
news.title_original: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
news.body_original: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

news.title: 开放语音识别评测新增埃及与尼日利亚英语
news.body: Open ASR Leaderboard 与 Liva AI 合作增加两种口音的私有测试数据，以扩展代表性并减少针对公开测试集调优的影响。榜单结论仍取决于语料和任务覆盖。
news.title_original: Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard

news.title: Cult.fit 分享 Codex 在运营与工具开发中的应用
news.body: 案例介绍工程和非工程团队用 Codex 构建内部应用，并通过 API 开发会员体验。节省成本及效率数据来自企业自报，实际收益依赖组织条件。
news.title_original: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
news.body_original: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

papers.title: 物理先验约束原子间势的不确定性估计
papers.body: arXiv:2611.09325v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standard uncertainty quantification methods for machine learning interatomic potentials often fail to quantify the effects of model misspecification despite its prominence as a source of error. To combat this, misspecification-aware uncertainty schemes have been gaining attention, pointwise optimal parameter set regression (POPS-Regression) among them. However, no guarantees on the physicality of the posterior distribution are given and uncertainty estimates can be conservative compared to the true error. To combat this, we present a model misspecification aware scheme that builds on POPS-Regression by allowing users to specify physical priors

papers.title: 机器学习势模拟应变对 Li3YCl6 离子输运的影响
papers.body: arXiv:2605.05603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solid-state batteries require electrolytes that sustain high ionic conductivity under the mechanical environment of a functioning cell. Lattice strain, arising from stack pressure, lattice mismatch at interfaces, and more importantly electrochemical cycling, can either enhance or suppress Li$^+$ transport in solid electrolytes, yet how it couples to the underlying diffusion mechanism in Li3YCl6 remains poorly understood. Using Li3YCl6 halide superionic conductor, we address this with large-scale molecular dynamics simulations driven by an Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) machine learning interatomic potential trained on first-principles data.
